title: Validate Method Flow witness parity without assuming one pair per method
failure_signature: A closeout test expected exactly ten failed and ten passing witnesses for ten methods and rejected an additional truthful recurrence pair.
candidate_workaround: Require exact method-ID coverage, failed/passing parity, and at least one pair per method while allowing additional retained recurrence witnesses.
recurrence_guard: Witness counts may exceed method counts; tests must preserve repetitions instead of compressing them to one synthetic pair.
rollback: Retain the failed closeout run, award no validation credit, and replace only the invalid cardinality assumption.
scope_boundary: Owner-local Method Flow validation only; no independent reproduction, production, scientific, or authority credit.
